description:
In Episode 242 we discuss the new 2025–2030 Dietary Guidelines for Americans that were unveiled by U.S. Health and Human Services Secretary Robert F. Kennedy Jr., as part of the "Make America Healthy Again" movement. The new guideline is an inverted "upside-down" food pyramid. In an online episode of Redacted, they discuss the new pyramid, but also how the previous pyramid came to be. Moreover, they introduced a lot of speculative statements and misinformation implying that Seventh Day Adventists were somehow responsible for the diabetes and obesity pandemic in the USA through their involvement with the previous pyramid. Is this true?
